title: Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami
summary: A magnitude 9.1 earthquake off Sumatra sent tsunamis across the Indian Ocean, killing about 230,000 people in fourteen countries.
reason: The Indian Plate slipped under the Burma Plate along a 1,300 kilometre rupture, and there was no warning system in the ocean.
significance: It was one of the deadliest natural disasters in history and led to a global tsunami warning network.
place: Off the west coast of Sumatra, Indonesia
